Top row: four full-body views, front, three-quarter, profile and back, in one identical neutral pose at one height on one baseline, fully uncropped with margins. Below: eight head-and-shoulders close-ups in two rows of four, facing camera, in this order: neutral, happy, delighted, sad, surprised, confused, angry, talking, same face, hair, age and outfit in every figure with necklace preserved in every portrait.
